entities.summary: Rosa Laudelina Chiquichano Nahuelquir is an Argentine lawyer and politician of Tehuelche-Mapuche descent who served as Deputy for the province of Chubut between 2007 and 2011. When assuming the position, she became the first member of the Tehuelche people to take a seat in the National Congress.
